name: Tiramisu
desc: Espresso-dipped ladyfingers layered with a no-egg mascarpone whipped cream and dusted with cocoa.

source.title: Tiramisu
source.evidence: Ingredient lines and steps match the Tastes Better From Scratch recipe word for word, including the Kahlua or DaVinci note, the cookie-aisle ladyfingers and the 8x8 pan.

ingredients.raw: 8 oz mascarpone cheese (1 container), room temperature
3 tbsp coffee liqueur, such as Kahlua or DaVinci (optional)
ingredients.note: such as Kahlua or DaVinci; optional

ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz) package Savoiardi ladyfingers (about 24), from the cookie aisle
1-2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, for dusting

steps: Beat the cream in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed. Slowly add the sugar and vanilla and keep beating to stiff peaks.
Add the mascarpone and fold it in until combined. Set aside.
Stir the espresso and liqueur together in a shallow bowl. Dip each ladyfinger quickly on both sides (do not soak it) and lay them in a single layer in an 8x8 in dish.
Spread half the mascarpone cream over the ladyfingers. Add a second layer of dipped ladyfingers and spread the rest of the cream on top.
Dust cocoa generously over the top through a fine-mesh strainer. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hr, or overnight, until set.
tips: Leave out the liqueur for an alcohol-free version, or use dark rum, brandy or marsala.
Keeps 2-3 days in the fridge. To freeze, skip the cocoa, wrap tightly and freeze up to 3 months; thaw overnight in the fridge and dust with cocoa a few hours before serving.
